method_name: DgCD-inspired ViT discrepancy-guided channel dropout for CoRP
preserved_official_semantics: rho-scaled normalized gradient updates for temporary scaler parameters
score from squared aligned discrepancy followed by per-sample min-max scaling
one random middle layer plus the final candidate layer
corp_adaptations: CNN feature map [B,C,H,W] is mapped to ViT block output [B,C,views,tokens]
the mask is shared across three views and all CLS/patch tokens
DgCD scoring is computed in FP32 while the main model remains BF16 autocast
local scaler backward updates temporary tensors and not the model optimizer
batches contain 3 contiguous single-style environment groups of 32 samples
within each style group, available tasks receive balanced sample quotas
candidate ViT layers are 2,5,8,11 with one random layer from 2,5,8 plus layer 11

matched_random_control.only_difference: random channel scores replace DgCD discrepancy scores
